gmail_get_thread.label: Get Thread
gmail_get_thread.description: Get a thread from your Gmail account via Id

thread_id.label: Thread ID
thread_id.description: The thread Id of the mail to read

gmail_send_draft.label: Send Draft
gmail_send_draft.description: Send an existing draft email by its ID.

draft_id.label: Draft ID
draft_id.description: The ID of the draft to send (obtain from List Drafts).

gmail_get_draft.label: Get Draft
gmail_get_draft.description: Get a single draft email by its ID.

draft_id.label: Draft ID
draft_id.description: The ID of the draft to read (obtain from List Drafts).

gmail_list_drafts.label: List Drafts
gmail_list_drafts.description: List draft emails in the mailbox.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Optional Gmail search query to filter drafts (e.g. "subject:invoice").

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of drafts to return (1-500).

gmail_list_drafts.afterResponse:
var drafts = response.drafts || [];
return Object.assign({drafts: drafts, count: drafts.length, resultSizeEstimate: response.resultSizeEstimate}, response.nextPageToken ? {nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken} : {});

gmail_list_threads.label: List Threads
gmail_list_threads.description: List email conversation threads in the mailbox.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Optional Gmail search query to filter threads (e.g. "from:boss@example.com is:unread").

label_ids.label: Label IDs
label_ids.description: Optional list of label IDs to filter by (resolve via List Labels; system labels like INBOX, UNREAD are valid). A JSON list, such as ["INBOX"].

include_spam_trash.label: Include Spam & Trash
include_spam_trash.description: Include threads from Spam and Trash in the results.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of threads to return (1-500).

gmail_list_threads.afterResponse:
var threads = response.threads || [];
return Object.assign({threads: threads, count: threads.length, resultSizeEstimate: response.resultSizeEstimate}, response.nextPageToken ? {nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken} : {});

gmail_list_labels.label: List Labels
gmail_list_labels.description: List all labels in the mailbox.
gmail_list_labels.afterResponse:
var labels = response.labels || [];
return {labels: labels, count: labels.length};

gmail_get_label.label: Get Label
gmail_get_label.description: Get a single label by its ID, including message and thread counts.

label_id.label: Label ID
label_id.description: The ID of the label to read (obtain from List Labels).

gmail_list_history.label: List History
gmail_list_history.description: List mailbox changes since a given history ID.

start_history_id.label: Start History ID
start_history_id.description: Return changes after this history ID (obtain from Get Profile or a previous history result).

history_types.label: History Types
history_types.description: Limit results to these change types (leave empty for all). A list of: messageAdded, messageDeleted, labelAdded, labelRemoved.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of history records to return (1-500).

gmail_stop_watch.label: Stop Watch
gmail_stop_watch.description: Stop push notifications on the mailbox.

gmail_create_label.label: Create Label
gmail_create_label.description: Create a new label in the mailbox.

name.label: Label Name
name.description: Appears in your Gmail label list.

gmail_add_label_to_email.label: Add Label to Email
gmail_add_label_to_email.description: Apply a label to an email message.

message_id.label: Message
message_id.description: Pick a recent message, or map its ID from a trigger or Find Email.

gmail_remove_label_from_email.label: Remove Label From Email
gmail_remove_label_from_email.description: Remove a label from an email message.

message_id.label: Message
message_id.description: Pick a recent message, or map its ID from a trigger or Find Email.

gmail_archive_email.label: Archive Email
gmail_archive_email.description: Archive an email message by removing it from the inbox.

message_id.label: Message
message_id.description: Pick a recent message, or map its ID from a trigger or Find Email.

gmail_get_or_create_label.label: Get or Create Label
gmail_get_or_create_label.description: Get an existing label by name, creating it first if it does not exist.

name.label: Label Name
name.description: The exact display name of the label, e.g. "Follow Up". Matching is case-sensitive.

gmail_modify_labels.label: Modify Labels
gmail_modify_labels.description: Add and/or remove labels across one or more email messages in a single call.

message_ids.label: Message IDs
message_ids.description: The Gmail message IDs to modify (obtain from Search Email or Get Message). Up to 1000 per call. A JSON list, such as ["18c2f0a1b2c3d4e5"].

add_label_ids.label: Label IDs to Add
add_label_ids.description: Label IDs to add to every message listed above (obtain from List Labels or Get or Create Label). A JSON list, such as ["INBOX"].

remove_label_ids.label: Label IDs to Remove
remove_label_ids.description: Label IDs to remove from every message listed above (obtain from List Labels). A JSON list, such as ["INBOX"].

gmail_trash_message.label: Trash Message
gmail_trash_message.description: Move an email message to Trash.

message_id.label: Message ID
message_id.description: The Gmail message ID to move to Trash (obtain from Search Email or Get Message).

gmail_untrash_message.label: Untrash Message
gmail_untrash_message.description: Restore an email message from Trash.

message_id.label: Message ID
message_id.description: The Gmail message ID to restore from Trash (obtain from Search Email or Get Message).

gmail_update_label.label: Update Label
gmail_update_label.description: Rename, recolor, or change the visibility of a user label.

label_id.label: Label ID
label_id.description: The ID of the user label to update (obtain from List Labels).

name.label: New Name
name.description: Leave empty to keep the current name.

label_list_visibility.label: Label List Visibility
label_list_visibility.description: Leave unselected to keep the current setting.

message_list_visibility.label: Message List Visibility
message_list_visibility.description: Leave unselected to keep the current setting.

background_color.label: Background Color (hex)
background_color.description: Leave empty to keep the current background color.

text_color.label: Text Color (hex)
text_color.description: Leave empty to keep the current text color.

gmail_modify_thread_labels.label: Modify Thread Labels
gmail_modify_thread_labels.description: Add and/or remove labels across every message in a thread in a single call.

thread_id.label: Thread ID
thread_id.description: The Gmail thread ID to modify (obtain from Search Email or Get Thread).

add_label_ids.label: Label IDs to Add
add_label_ids.description: Label IDs to add to every message in the thread (obtain from List Labels or Get or Create Label). A JSON list, such as ["INBOX"].

remove_label_ids.label: Label IDs to Remove
remove_label_ids.description: Label IDs to remove from every message in the thread (obtain from List Labels). A JSON list, such as ["INBOX"].
